sections.section: Original application, push, CI and cloud footage

new_cards.narration: The slides reflect the final project results. The next section preserves the actual application and cloud recording, including the real push and completed pipeline. The AWS services shown were running during that capture and have since been removed. This is recorded evidence, not a claim that the cloud deployment is live now.

The final cleanup completed after this recording. Terraform destroyed fifty-nine resources, and all eleven audit checks passed. The cluster and VPC are absent, all four instances are terminated, and the application data volumes are deleted. The owned encryption key is pending its scheduled deletion on November fifteenth, twenty twenty-six. The repository contains the code, slides, exact script and all evidence. This video uses the MacBook Samantha voice. Thank you.
